approach.summary: Add symlink check before os.replace to prevent target path symlink attacks
approach.description: Before calling os.replace(temp_path, self.path), check if self.path is a symlink and reject it by raising ValueError. This prevents an attacker from pre-creating a symlink at the database path pointing to a sensitive file, which would cause os.replace to overwrite the target file.

risks: Existing users with symlinks at the database path will now get an error - this is intentional security hardening
